sources_used: Datadog 10-K FY2025 customer / ARR / product disclosure

kpis.description_fr: Expansion nette des cohortes existantes. >120% = best-in-class SaaS infra. Inflexion 2023 (cloud optim) puis rebond 2025 IA/LLM observability.
kpis.description_en: Net expansion of existing cohorts. >120% = best-in-class SaaS infra. 2023 dip (cloud optimization), 2025 rebound from AI/LLM observability.

kpis.description_fr: Indicateur de cross-sell réussi (>20 produits dispos : Logs, APM, RUM, Security, LLM Obs, etc.). Cœur de la stratégie plateforme.
kpis.description_en: Successful cross-sell metric (20+ products: Logs, APM, RUM, Security, LLM Obs, etc.). Core platform strategy KPI.

kpis.description_fr: Pourcentage du revenu restant après déduction des coûts directs d'infrastructure cloud et de personnel.
kpis.description_en: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting direct cloud infrastructure hosting and personnel costs.
kpis._specific_to: SaaS platform metric; reflects pricing power and infrastructure efficiency specific to cloud-based monitoring/observability business

kpis_story.description_fr: Bits AI = assistant IA générative pour observabilité (DevOps copilot). Premium monetization possible.
kpis_story.description_en: Bits AI = generative AI assistant for observability (DevOps copilot). Premium monetization potential.

kpis_story.description_fr: Nouveau produit dédié monitoring LLM (latency, hallucinations, coût). Tailwind AI-native customers.
kpis_story.description_en: New product for LLM monitoring (latency, hallucinations, cost). AI-native customers tailwind.

_notes: DDOG = leader cloud observability multi-pilier (infra + APM + logs + security). Land-and-expand model.
